topics.title: Stern Disputes FCC Regulations
topics.summary: Howard Stern vehemently criticizes attempts by regulatory bodies, specifically the Federal Communications Commission (FCC), to control broadcast content. He argues against censorship, expresses frustration with perceived bias from media outlets and financial penalties, and dismisses concerns about creative expression as a tactic to silence dissenting voices.

topics.title: Detective Cregan Investigates Missing Boys
topics.summary: Former detective David Cregan, returning from a period of clinical insanity, is investigating the disappearance of several boys and aggressively pursues leads with unsettling methods, raising concerns about corruption within law enforcement and potential threats to outsiders.

topics.title: News Roundup: Marriage Disputes and Strange Incidents
topics.summary: A variety of news stories are presented, including debates surrounding same-sex marriage across the United States – from Mayor Gavin Newsom’s stance in San Francisco to legal challenges in Seattle and Wisconsin. A bizarre incident involving a man severing his genitalia is reported alongside a Burger King lawsuit over a hot burger injury. Additionally, discussions about evangelical groups, Hollywood actors like Mel Gibson and Drew Barrymore, and a bombing investigation in Spain conclude the broadcast.

topics.title: Breast Implants & The Gaydar Game
topics.summary: During a radio show, Howard attempts to determine if three callers are straight or gay by asking them about their favorite Broadway musicals and personal preferences. As the conversation progresses, he offers a $1000 prize for breast implants, leading to awkward questions about sex, body image, and perceived desires, ultimately revealing two of the callers identify as gay.

topics.title: Attempting to Determine Sexual Orientation
topics.summary: A group engages in a nonsensical attempt to determine a person's sexual orientation through increasingly bizarre methods, including kissing and observing physical reactions. They suggest outlandish actions like removing clothing or seeking breast implants for guidance before ultimately settling on a random selection of individuals based on limited information.

topics.title: St. Patrick’s Day Chaos
topics.summary: During a live broadcast, hosts and guests engage in chaotic conversation centered around St. Patrick's Day, featuring misremembered details about coverage areas, bizarre character introductions (a bat named Chief and Helen with a shamrock tattoo), an attempt to sell Corona beer alongside WWE wrestling discussions including the Rock versus Mick Foley.
